info.title: Gremion kernel API: core (tenancy and the module registry)
info.description: TASK-077 (L3-17; TRD-407 first half, TRD-082, TRD-353). The kernel API's one spec (Q5, Q11): dependants append their operations under their own tag (bodies: TASK-080, authz: TASK-081) and their handlers to src/handlers/index.ts, sorted by operationId. Every operation except getHealth is tenant-resolved: the WHOLE X-Forwarded-Host (equal to Host) selects the customer in the control registry, behind the proxy-trust header; or a module caller asserts the customer id with its own module secret. Every response body is checked against this document before it is sent (Q4): an undeclared field is a 500 response-contract-violation, never a silent drop.

get.summary: The customer's settings that shape every person's UI

200.description: idt.customer_setting of the resolved customer: the default locale a person following the customer gets. A customer without a row (not yet migrated past the hook) answers the column defaults.

bearer.description: An access token of the resolved customer's realm: exact iss (the customer's issuer), aud containing gremion-kernel-api, RS256, exp/nbf (Q7; RFC 8725, RFC 9068).

moduleCaller.name: x-internal-auth
moduleCaller.description: A module calling back into the kernel (Q8, the four B8 clauses): x-gremion-module names it, x-internal-auth matches its own KERNEL_API_MODULE_SECRET_<ID>, x-tenant-id asserts the customer (a UUIDv7), the operation is on the module-caller allowlist, and the module is enabled for that customer.

ForwardedHost.name: x-forwarded-host
ForwardedHost.description: The customer's host, whole (Tenancy D1). Must equal Host. Absent on a module-caller request.

ProxyTrust.name: x-proxy-trust
ProxyTrust.description: The proxy shared secret (TENANT_PROXY_SHARED_SECRET). Absent on a module-caller request.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds until the client should retry.

Unauthorized.description: No, or an unacceptable, credential for the resolved customer.

Forbidden.description: The request did not prove it came through the proxy, or a module caller may not call this operation for this customer.

NotFound.description: No customer is served at this host (unparseable, reserved, unbound or not active). There is no default customer.

Unavailable.description: The customer is suspended, its kernel database is behind its manifest, unreachable or skewed against this image, or the control registry is unreachable. Never cached.

InternalError.description: An internal error, or a response that would have broken this document (response-contract-violation).

BadRequest.description: The request did not match the operation's schema.

Conflict.description: The write conflicts with the current state (an overlapping validity, a taken e-mail address, a stale row version).

CustomerId.description: DB-TNT-CUSTOMER id: a canonical lower-case UUIDv7.

ModuleRuntime.description: The runtime block of modules/<key>/module.json (spec D D.1.2), served only for the version the customer enabled.

Body.description: DB-IDT-BODY: a Gremium, the authorisation scope.

OrgUnit.description: DB-IDT-ORGUNIT: a unit of a body.

BodyTree.description: Every body and org unit of the customer; the client builds the tree from parentBodyId / parentOrgUnitId.

Seat.description: DB-IDT-SEAT with its holders today (open tenures that have started).

Tenure.description: DB-IDT-TENURE: one holding of a seat; the seat history is the list of these.

Membership.description: DB-IDT-MEMBERSHIP. Carries the person by id only.

Person.description: DB-IDT-PERSON. Personal data: served to the person themself only.

Preference.description: DB-IDT-PREFERENCE of the signed-in person; effectiveLocale resolves follow_customer through idt.customer_setting.default_locale. rowVersion 0 and stored false until the person first saves.

Written.description: The id and row version of the aggregate the write created.
